dslRule:
<!id: field.type.widen.list.to.collection>
<!description: Widen private field type from java.util.List<IMarker> to java.util.Collection<IMarker>.
This is a safe refactoring as List is a subtype of Collection.>
<!severity: HINT>

private java.util.List<org.eclipse.core.resources.IMarker> $name;
=>
private java.util.Collection<org.eclipse.core.resources.IMarker> $name;
;;
summary: Widen private field type from List<IMarker> to Collection<IMarker>
